svg.aria-label: Left: RMS error of plain Monte Carlo estimates of an integral against the number of samples on log-log axes, in 1 and in 10 dimensions; both lines have slope minus one half, the 10-dimensional one higher because its integrand has larger variance. Right: the first 5,000 steps of Metropolis-Hastings chains on a target with modes at plus and minus 3, for random-walk proposals of width 0.1, 2.5 and 50; the narrow chain never leaves its first mode, the middle one moves between the modes often, and the wide one rarely moves at all
svg.text: Monte Carlo error does not depend on d
